formulaIdentity.fingerprintMethod: sha256 of packet canonicalInci joined with ', ' (as frozen, before ID-2 normalization)
formulaIdentity.sourceTier: frozen packet canonical INCI; positioning: manufacturer + 2 retailers
formulaIdentity.normalizationNote: Packet entries 1 'Aqua (Water' and 2 'Eau)' are one ingredient 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' (ID-2). All positions below are normalized: packet position minus 1 from entry 3 on (33 packet entries -> 32 ingredients).
formulaIdentity.conflictNotes: 'Panthenol-Feuchtigkeits-Komplex' maps to Panthenol (7); the 3% figure cannot be verified from INCI (3.2). No conflict.

cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2) buffered by prominent Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3); no reinforcing anionic. PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (5) is a weak refatter, Laureth-4/-23 and Trideceth-10 are not routes (C3). 'Reinigt sanft' cannot move it (Section 4).

conditioningLevel.rationale: High by C2: early (prominent) Dimethicone (8), cationic Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (13), pearlizing Glycol Distearate (16), humectant Panthenol (7); reinforced by Amodimethicone (12), Hydrolyzed Keratin (6), PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate (5), Hydrogenated Castor Oil (15) and Apricot Kernel Oil (21). Counter-signal toward moderate: guar/pearlizer/lipids are post-fragrance.

excluded: PEG-120 Methyl Glucose Dioleate (18): PEG thickener (6.4)

depositionLoad.rationale: Prominent dimethicone plus amodimethicone and guar, a prominent hydrolyzed keratin, and post-fragrance waxy/liquid lipids: several routes, but lipids late and keratin hydrolyzed.

persistence.rationale: Silicones (incl. amodimethicone) are persistent; hydrolyzed keratin is weakly retained; hydrogenated castor oil is waxy but post-fragrance.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Multiple converging families (two silicones incl. amodimethicone, guar, keratin, waxy lipid) argue toward high; no prominent payload lipid (no W-RICH) and an ordinary SLES reset argue against.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Silicone/guar system reinforced by light routes leaves noticeable but bounded residue under ordinary reset.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: the only prominent depositing systems are dimethicone and a hydrolyzed (low-persistence) keratin; amodimethicone, guar and lipids are post-fragrance, W-RICH is not met and reset is not limited, so a coating conclusion is not supported. Not low: prominent silicone plus amodimethicone/guar is a plausible persistent system. W1 not applied: condition (c) fails because the prominent Hydrolyzed Keratin (6) reinforces the set, so the full 6.6 method decided.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Several converging families; realistic silicone levels could move it to high.
weightPotential.rationale: Moderate by the full 6.6 method (W1 excluded by its condition c).

careDirection.limitation: Moisture humectant cluster is essentially Panthenol alone; repair cluster rests on hydrolyzed keratin plus amodimethicone.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Thin humectant cluster (Panthenol only prominent); keratin + amodimethicone also support repair; 'stärkt das Haar von innen' points to repair.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Formula verdict dual_supported. Manufacturer positioning is dominated by moisture/nourishment ('Panthenol-Feuchtigkeits-Komplex', 'Spendet langanhaltende Feuchtigkeit', 'Nährt'), graded moderate, which may break the tie (3.2, CL-SRC) -> moisture (F1). Curl/wave wording is hair_texture. 'Tiefenpflegende' is care wording.
focusPrimary.rationale: moisture by F1: dual_supported formula, tie broken by dominant moderate-graded moisture positioning.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered. Candidate repair: route keratin (6) + amodimethicone (12) would be independent (F3), but the claim 'stärkt das Haar von innen' is generic strengthening, not damage/breakage/bond positioning (F1), so condition 1 of Section 8 is not met.

usageRole.decisionTrace: Default regular; no frequency, reset or dandruff trigger. 'Tiefenspülung' in directions is care wording, not D1.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No E2 sensitive/dry unit; 'Reinigt sanft die Kopfhaut' is mildness (SC1).

projection.thicknessRationale: T1 W moderate, C high: fine acceptable, normal ideal, coarse ideal. Ordinary, no T6. T4: fine acceptable -> W neighbor high gives not_suited (ordinary) -> flag fine; normal ideal -> W neighbor high gives acceptable -> flag normal; coarse ideal -> C neighbor moderate gives acceptable -> flag coarse. Curl wording ignored (T2).
projection.scalpTargetRationale: S-ORDINARY way 1; manufacturer source present -> high (13.8).
projection.cleansingIntensityRationale: I1 moderate -> regular; matches normal; I3 neighbor none.
projection.deepCleanserRationale: D1 false: 'Tiefenpflegende' and 'Tiefenspülung' are explicitly not D1; D2 not met.

uncertainties: Packet INCI splits 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' into two entries; positions normalized per ID-2. Other lanes may cite packet positions (+1).
Weight moderate vs high close to W3 balance (two silicones + guar + keratin + waxy lipid); recorded moderate/moderate with neighbor high.
Care direction dual vs repair_supported depends on whether Panthenol alone is a 'coherent humectant cluster' (7.3).
